name: NDA & NA Examination
qual: Class 12 (PCM for Air Force & Naval wings)
pattern: Written (Mathematics 300 + GAT 600) → SSB Interview (900) → Medical → Merit
salary: Stipend ₹56,100/month during training; Lt pay Level 10
summary: The National Defence Academy exam is the primary route for 12th-pass candidates to become officers in all three services after three years at Khadakwasla and a year at the respective service academy.
tips: Mathematics is 300 marks with negative marking — speed on class 11-12 topics decides the cut-off.
GAT English (200 marks) is the easiest score to bank; do not neglect it.
Prepare SSB in parallel: only ~8% of written qualifiers are recommended.

name: Combined Defence Services Examination
service: Army / Navy / Air Force (IMA, INA, AFA, OTA)
gender: Men & Women (OTA for both; IMA/INA/AFA men)
qual: Graduate (any stream for IMA/OTA; Engineering for INA; Physics & Maths at 12th or BE for AFA)
pattern: Written (English, GK, Maths — Maths not for OTA) → SSB → Medical
salary: Lt / Sub Lt / Flying Officer — Level 10 (₹56,100 basic + MSP ₹15,500)
summary: CDS is the graduate-entry gateway to permanent commission via IMA, INA and AFA, and short service commission via OTA Chennai.
tips: Choose academy preferences carefully — age limits differ: IMA 20-24, INA 20-24, AFA 20-24, OTA 19-25.
OTA has no Maths paper; graduates from humanities routinely clear it.
Final merit combines written + SSB, so both matter equally.

name: Air Force Common Admission Test
service: Air Force (Flying, Ground Duty Technical & Non-Technical)
qual: Graduate 60% (Physics & Maths at 12th for Flying); BE/BTech for Technical
pattern: Online AFCAT (100 Q, 300 marks) + EKT for Technical → AFSB → Medical
salary: Flying Officer — Level 10 + MSP + Flying allowance
summary: AFCAT is the IAF's own entry for short service commission in Flying branch and permanent/short service in Ground Duty branches.
tips: Flying branch age is 20-24; Ground duty 20-26 at course commencement.
EKT is additional for technical branch — engineering fundamentals.
AFSB is conducted at Dehradun, Mysuru, Gandhinagar and Varanasi.

name: Agniveer — Indian Army (GD, Technical, Clerk/SKT, Tradesman)
pattern: Online CEE → Rally (PFT, PMT) → Medical → Merit
salary: ₹30,000 (Yr1) rising to ₹40,000 (Yr4) + Seva Nidhi ₹10.04 lakh at exit
summary: Agnipath's four-year enrolment for soldiers; 25% retained as regular cadre after four years. The single largest defence recruitment by volume.
tips: Online CEE is now the first stage — rally follows only for qualifiers.
1.6 km run timing groups decide bonus marks in PFT.
Register on joinindianarmy.nic.in with Aadhaar-linked mobile early.

name: Agniveervayu — Indian Air Force
qual: Class 12 with Maths, Physics & English (50%) or 3-year diploma / vocational
pattern: Online STAR exam → Phase II (PFT, adaptability tests, document verification) → Medical
summary: The IAF's Agnipath intake for airmen-equivalent Agniveervayu, tested through the online STAR examination and a physical fitness test.
tips: The STAR exam has a Science and an Other-than-Science stream — pick per your 12th subjects.
Only official site publishes the free mock test — use it.
Normalisation applies across shifts.

name: Agniveer — Indian Navy (SSR & MR)
pattern: INET-Agniveer online exam → PFT → Medical
summary: Senior Secondary Recruit (SSR) and Matric Recruit (MR) entries for sailors under Agnipath; women are inducted in both.
tips: SSR shortlisting is based on 12th marks before the exam — keep your score sheet ready.
MR covers chef, steward and hygienist roles.
PFT: 1.6 km run in 6 min 30 s, 20 squats, 15 push-ups.

name: SSB Interview (Services Selection Board)
freq: Continuous — after every officer written / shortlist
pattern: Day 1 Screening (OIR + PPDT) → Days 2-4 Psychology, GTO, Personal Interview → Day 5 Conference
summary: The five-day SSB assesses 15 Officer-Like Qualities through psychologist, GTO and interviewing officer. Recommendation rate hovers around 5-10%.
tips: Practise OIR verbal & non-verbal reasoning for speed — screening-out is ~60%.
Write a genuine PIQ form; every interview question flows from it.
Physical fitness matters in GTO tasks; run and do obstacle training beforehand.

name: Technical Entry Scheme (10+2 TES)
qual: Class 12 with PCM 60% aggregate + JEE Main appeared
pattern: Shortlist on JEE Main rank → SSB → Medical
salary: Stipend during training; Lt on commissioning (Level 10)
summary: Direct engineering-officer entry for 12th pass; five years of training leads to a B.Tech and permanent commission.
tips: No written exam — JEE Main score is the gate.
Very limited vacancies (~90) — cut-offs are high.
SSB call letters go by JEE rank order.

name: Technical Graduate Course
pattern: Shortlist on engineering marks → SSB → Medical → Merit
summary: Permanent-commission entry for engineering graduates with one-year training at IMA; no written exam.
tips: Cut-off is by branch percentage — keep CGPA conversion certificate ready.
Stream-wise vacancies change every course.
Ante-date seniority is granted for the engineering degree.

name: Short Service Commission (Technical) — Men & Women
pattern: Shortlist on marks → SSB → Medical
summary: Short service commission (10 + 4 years) for engineers, with an option to convert to permanent commission.
tips: Widow of defence personnel category has its own vacancies.
Applications go through the Army's online portal only.
OTA Chennai training is 49 weeks.

name: NCC Special Entry Scheme
pattern: No written exam → SSB → Medical
summary: Senior-division NCC cadets with a 'C' certificate skip the written test and go straight to SSB for short service commission.
tips: Wards of battle casualties have a reserved sub-quota.
Only two years validity of 'C' certificate matters — check the notification.
Ideal parallel track for CDS aspirants with NCC background.

name: Indian Navy SSC Officer (Executive, Technical, Education)
pattern: Shortlist on graduation marks → SSB → Medical
summary: The Navy's graduate short-service commission covering General Service, Pilot, Observer, ATC, Naval Armament Inspection, Logistics, Education and Technical branches.
tips: Different branches have different age bands — read the table, not the headline.
Pilot/Observer require CPSS at the SSB.
Applications open on the Navy portal for about two weeks — set an alert.

name: 10+2 (B.Tech) Cadet Entry — Indian Navy
pattern: Shortlist on JEE Main rank → SSB → Medical
salary: Stipend during training; Sub Lt on commissioning
summary: Four-year B.Tech at the Indian Naval Academy, Ezhimala, leading to permanent commission in Executive or Technical branches.
tips: Shortlisting is purely JEE Main based — no separate written.
Roughly 30-40 vacancies per course; women included since 2023.
Choose Executive vs Technical preference in the application.

name: CAPF Assistant Commandant (UPSC)
pattern: Written (Paper I objective, Paper II descriptive) → PET/PST → Medical → Interview
summary: Group A entry into the Central Armed Police Forces — India's largest uniformed employer after the Army.
tips: Paper II (essay, précis, comprehension) is the differentiator — practise writing.
PET: 100 m in 16 s (men) / 18 s (women), 800 m, long jump, shot put.
Age relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 for OBC.

name: Territorial Army Officer
pattern: Written (Reasoning & Elementary Maths; GK & English) → PIB Interview → SSB → Medical
summary: The 'citizen's army' allows working professionals to serve part-time as commissioned officers, with embodiment for training and operations.
tips: Proof of gainful employment is mandatory at the PIB stage.
Written exam pattern is lighter than CDS; PIB screening is the real hurdle.
Popular second attempt route for CDS over-age candidates.

name: Indian Coast Guard Assistant Commandant (CGCAT)
qual: Graduate 60% with Maths & Physics at 12th (GD); BE/BTech (Technical)
pattern: CGCAT online exam → Stage II (PSB: PP&DT, interview) → FSB → Medical
summary: Officer entry into the Coast Guard's General Duty, Commercial Pilot, Technical and Law branches through the CGCAT.
tips: Technical branch age is 21-27 (vs 21-25 GD).
PP&DT is identical to SSB screening — same preparation applies.
Height 157 cm minimum; eyesight standards stricter for GD.

name: Indian Coast Guard Navik (GD / DB) & Yantrik
qual: Class 12 with Maths & Physics (GD); Class 10 (DB); Diploma (Yantrik)
pattern: Stage I online exam → Stage II (PFT, document verification, initial medical) → Stage III final medical
summary: Enrolled-personnel entry for the Coast Guard — regular service, not Agnipath.
tips: Zone-wise vacancies — check your state's zone.
Swimming test of 50 m is part of training, not selection.
Yantrik requires 3-year engineering diploma with 60%.

name: SSC GD Constable (BSF, CRPF, CISF, ITBP, SSB, Assam Rifles)
pattern: Computer-based exam (80 Q, 160 marks) → PET/PST → Medical
summary: The largest single uniformed recruitment in India — vacancies routinely exceed 40,000.
tips: Negative marking of 0.25 — accuracy first.
PET: 5 km in 24 min (men), 1.6 km in 8.5 min (women).
Force preference order in the form decides allotment.

name: Judge Advocate General (JAG) Entry
pattern: Shortlist on CLAT PG score → SSB → Medical
summary: Short service commission for law graduates in the Army's legal branch; shortlisting now uses CLAT PG scores.
tips: Equal vacancies for men and women in recent courses.
CLAT PG score of the current year only is accepted.
Post-commission you can practise military law across courts martial.

name: Sainik School Entrance (AISSEE) & RIMC
qual: Class 5 (for Class 6 entry) / Class 8 (for Class 9 entry)
pattern: Written (Maths, Intelligence, Language, GK) → e-counselling → Medical
summary: Sainik Schools and RIMC are the traditional pipeline into NDA — a large share of NDA cadets come from these 33+ schools.
tips: Class 6 entry: age 10-12 as on 31 March of admission year.
Girls admitted in Class 6 across all Sainik Schools since 2021-22.
RIMC has a separate exam (June & December) with state quotas.
